line.name: Portable Buildings
line.intro: Wood portable buildings arrive complete. They are built in a shop, trucked to your property, and set on your prepared spot in a single visit — no assembly, no kit, no crew. Because they sit on treated skids rather than a poured foundation, most sites need nothing more than level ground, and the building can be relocated later if you move.
line.deliveryNote: Portable buildings are delivered to Texas, Louisiana, Missouri, Illinois, Tennessee and Indiana. Outside those states, our steel building lines ship nationwide.

warranty.standard: 5-year limited warranty on workmanship and materials
warranty.specialty: 1-year limited warranty on Greenhouse, K-9 Condo, Chicken Coop and Playhouse models
warranty.siding: LP SmartSide siding and trim carries a 50-year manufacturer warranty
warranty.shingles: Dimensional shingles carry a manufacturer lifetime warranty
warranty.note: Warranty runs to the original purchaser and requires the original serial tag to remain attached and visible. It does not cover installation or reinstallation costs, or the natural tendency of wood to split, warp or twist.

traditional: 6 months deferred interest, or fixed APR from 9.99%
financing.note: Financing and lease-purchase programs are administered by third-party finance companies, and availability varies by area. Terms come from the finance provider, not from us.

construction.heading: Built not to sag or rot
points: Treated skids and joists on 16" centers, rated for ground contact
4x6 notched floor skids — two on 8' wide buildings, four on 10' and 12' wide
5/8" LP ProStruct treated floor decking with interlocking SmartFinish
Pulling blocks at the centermost skids so the building can be moved without damage

construction.heading: Finished, painted, warranted
points: LP SmartSide engineered wood siding and trim, treated against water and insects
Metal hurricane straps tying wall framing to rafters, rated to 160 mph
Glidden exterior paint in a choice of eleven colors

construction.heading: Shed water, vent heat
points: Aluminum drip edge protecting decking and eaves
Ridge vent to let heat escape at the peak
Choice of dimensional shingles or a metal roof

construction.heading: Hardware that survives daily use
points: Adjustable tension rods to stop the doors sagging
Aluminum threshold protecting the floor edge
Storm chains to prevent wind damage
Takes a standard padlock without modification

products.name: The Barn
products.headline: The best-seller, and the one with a real loft
products.intro: The Barn is the most-ordered building in the line, and the reason is vertical space. The gambrel roof shape that makes it look like a barn is doing structural work — it lifts the sidewalls of the loft high enough that the space above is genuinely usable rather than a crawl.
products.detail: If you are storing anything seasonal — decorations, camping gear, off-season furniture — the loft is where it goes, and it frees the entire floor for the things you actually reach for weekly. Available with single or double doors, and with the widest size range in the lineup.
products.height: Approximately 11'6" overall on a 12' wide building

products.name: Tool Shed
products.headline: The economical one, and often the right one
products.intro: A compact ranch-style building with shorter walls and a lower overall height. It is the least expensive way into the line, and for a mower, a wheelbarrow and a wall of hand tools it is frequently all anyone needs.
products.detail: Interior walls run about 6'3", so this is not the choice if you plan to stand tall shelving against them or work inside for long stretches. If that matters, the Tool Shed Tall is the same building with the height added.
products.height: Shorter overall height; interior walls approximately 6'3"

products.name: Tool Shed Tall
products.headline: Ranch styling with the wall height added back
products.intro: The most popular ranch-style building in the line. Same clean single-ridge roof as the Tool Shed, with taller sidewalls — which is the difference between a building you store things in and one you can work in.
products.detail: The extra wall height is what makes shelving, pegboard and a bench worth installing. It also covers the full size range up to 12' x 32', so it scales from a backyard shed to something closer to a workshop.
products.height: Approximately 10'6" overall on a 10' wide building

products.name: Cottage Shed
products.headline: The one that suits a front-yard-visible spot
products.intro: A distinctive roof profile that reads more like a small cottage than a utility building. If your shed will be visible from the house or the street — or if a covenant has opinions about outbuildings — this is the one that tends to pass without argument.
products.detail: The roof shape sheds weather well and gives the building a finished look without costing more than a plain gable. Practical storage capacity is comparable to a ranch-style building of the same footprint.
products.height: Approximately 9'8" overall on a 10' wide building

products.name: Cottage Shed Tall
products.headline: Cottage styling, more usable wall
products.intro: The Cottage Shed with additional wall height and two more floor plans. You keep the styling that made the shorter version worth choosing and gain the headroom that makes the interior properly usable.
products.detail: Worth the step up if the building will be entered daily, or if you intend to line the walls. The roof profile also gives slightly more protection at the eave than a flat gable.
products.height: Approximately 11'4" overall on a 10' wide building

products.name: Slim Shed
products.headline: For the gap beside the house
products.intro: A narrow lean-to profile with a single-slope roof, built for the strip of ground alongside an existing structure or fence line where nothing else fits. The 6' wide model in particular solves a problem most sheds cannot.
products.detail: The single slope means water runs off one side, so plan which way it faces relative to a path or a neighbouring wall. Double doors sit on the front sidewall, giving full-width access despite the narrow footprint.
features: Double doors on the front sidewall

products.name: Utility Handyman
products.headline: Two rooms, one building
products.intro: An interior partition splits this building into two separate spaces with their own access. One side becomes the workshop; the other stays storage — and the sawdust, the mess and the half-finished project stay on their own side of the wall.
products.detail: The partition is the whole point, and it is worth thinking about which side gets the window and which gets the wider door before you order. Ranch-style roofline with the taller utility sidewalls.

products.name: Barn Handyman
products.headline: The partitioned workshop, with a loft on top
products.intro: Same two-room layout as the Utility Handyman, built under a barn roof. You get the interior partition dividing workshop from storage, plus the overhead loft that the gambrel shape makes possible.
products.detail: This is the most storage-dense building in the range — two usable ground-floor rooms and a loft above both. If you are trying to get a workshop and a season's worth of storage onto one pad, this is the one that does it.

products.name: Utility Cabin
products.headline: A covered porch changes what the building is for
products.intro: Add a covered front porch, a residential entry door, three windows and taller sidewalls, and a storage building stops being storage. The Utility Cabin is built to be occupied — as a studio, an office, a guest space or a retreat at the back of the property.
products.detail: It arrives as a finished shell with the porch, door and windows in place. Insulation, wiring, interior finishes and anything else needed for regular occupancy are local work, and whether that requires a permit depends entirely on your jurisdiction and how you intend to use it.
products.height: Approximately 11'5" overall on a 12' wide building

products.name: Barn Cabin
products.headline: Cabin below, loft above
products.intro: The cabin package — covered porch, residential door, three windows, tall sidewalls — under a barn roof, which adds a loft over the living space. The loft is what makes a small footprint feel like more than one room.
products.detail: The gambrel roof gives real standing room upstairs rather than a token shelf, so a 12' x 32' Barn Cabin has meaningfully more usable volume than the same footprint under a ranch roof. Same caveats apply on insulation, utilities and permits.

products.name: Utility Garage
products.headline: Vehicle storage that arrives finished
products.intro: A portable garage delivered complete and set on your prepared ground. There is no slab to pour and no crew to schedule — which is most of the appeal when the alternative is a construction project.
products.detail: Sized for a car, a truck, a boat, motorcycles, mowers or ATVs, and equally useful as workshop or hobby space. Because it sits on skids rather than a foundation, check with your building department about how a portable garage is classified locally — the answer varies and it affects permitting.

products.name: Barn Garage
products.headline: Park below, store overhead
products.intro: Vehicle storage under a barn roof, which buys you an overhead loft the ranch-style garage does not have. Park the vehicle, put everything else upstairs.
products.detail: For anyone storing a seasonal vehicle — a boat, a bike, a classic — the loft usually ends up holding the covers, the spares and the gear that would otherwise crowd the floor around it.

products.name: Chicken Coop
products.headline: Built around egg collection and cleaning out
products.intro: A purpose-built wooden coop designed around the two jobs you do most: getting the eggs out and cleaning the thing. Latching doors and a ridge vent handle security and airflow, which are the two variables that decide whether a coop works.
products.detail: Ventilation matters more than most first-time keepers expect — a sealed coop holds moisture and ammonia, and that is what causes respiratory problems in a flock. The ridge vent lets that escape at the peak while the latching doors keep predators out.

products.name: K-9 Condo
products.headline: Enclosed inside, fenced run outside
products.intro: An 8' x 4' fully enclosed interior for warmth and shelter, opening through a large dog door onto a fully fenced, covered 8' x 8' porch. The dog moves between the two freely — sheltered when it wants to be, outside and in air when it does not.
products.detail: The covered run is the part that matters in practice. A kennel with no shade is unusable half the year in most of the delivery region, and one with no enclosed space is unusable the other half.

products.name: Greenhouse
products.headline: Extend the growing season at both ends
products.intro: A bright, roomy greenhouse with interior shelving on three sides and hooks overhead for hanging plants. Built to the same standard as the rest of the line rather than as a seasonal kit, which is the difference between a structure that lasts a decade and one that lasts two winters.
products.detail: Shelving on three walls plus overhead hooks gives you far more growing surface than the 8' x 12' footprint suggests. Think about orientation before it is set — which way it faces determines how much light it gets through the shoulder seasons.

products.name: Playhouse
products.headline: A real building, scaled for the people using it
products.intro: An 8' x 12' structure with a four-foot-deep covered front porch, built to the same standards as every other building in the range — the same treated floor, the same siding, the same warranted roof.
products.detail: That construction standard is the point. A playhouse built like a toy lasts a couple of seasons outdoors; this one is built like a shed, which means it survives the weather and converts easily into storage or a garden room once the kids outgrow it.
